items.text: Kisukuny ijo Aaron onacekon, ka odweke nepepe kaŋes, kodwe luka Isirael, kejaanak eoŋ kosasedotene, Aaron, ka Nadab ka Abiku, ka Eleasar ka Itamar, odwe luka Aaron,
Ido iswamakini onacekon Aaron inapen lukalaunak, kanuka aibuses ka ajokis da.
Ilimokini kere luejaas itauon luka apirianut, lueteleleb eoŋ kemoyo loka acoa, kiswamata inapen luka Aaron aitalaunia ŋes, kejaanak eoŋ kosasedotene.
Lu kes inapen luiswamaunete kesi; yenikatorob, ka epod,
ka ekaso, ka ekooti loocerer, ka egoe lokieniena akou, ka aenetait naka aŋabet: iswamakinete Aaron onacekon ka odweke inapen lukalaunak, kejaanak eoŋ kosasedotene.
Eyaŋaarete esa bu, ka lobululu, ka lomuge, ka Lokareŋan, ka ebaputa loejok,
Iswamaunete kesi epod loka esabu, ka lobululu, ka lomuge, ka Lokareŋan, ka ebaputa loecipitai kiusio lueriim, aswam naka ekeswaman kalocpiriana.
Ejaunos lukokeperin iarei luimorikikinitai kosanetakec iarei; tctere imorikikina.
Aenet da naicipitai kapirianut, naejai tomake aenia, koputos akeswam kaswam naka egoeke; loka esabu, ka lobululu, lomugc, lokarenan, ka ebaputa loecipitai kiusio lueriim.
Ido iyaŋaari amor aarei nuemelomeloto, kigiranak nen ikiroria luka idwe luka Isirael.
Ikiroriakec ikanykape amoru adiopet, ka ikiroria ikanykape luesalitos amoru nakiareit, kwape eiaar auriokec.
Aswam naka ekegiran amor, kwape igiria emacar, ŋes igiria ijo amor ŋun aarei kwape ejaatar ikiroria luka idwe luka Isirael: ilukuni kes kapesan nuka esabu.
Ibwaikini da amor nun aarei okeperin luka epod, araun amor nuka aisiitunet kanuka idwe luka Isirael: edakari Aaron ikiroriakec akonyen nuka EJAKAIT kokeperinike iarei araun aisntunet,
Ka irikoi iarei luka esabu kaloelai; iswamauni kwape kaunoi, kaswam kanaeojitoi: ienikini da irikoi lueoiitoi toma apesan.

Ido iswamauni yenikatorob yeniketube, aswam naka ekeswaman kaloepiriana: iswamauni kwape kaswam naka epod; yenika esabu, ka yenibululu, ka yenimuge, ka yenikarenan, ka ebaputa loecipitai kiusio lueriim, iswamauni ŋes kwaŋin.
Eraun yenika agoria aoŋon nueriakanara, ekudokinitai bala eriagi, aojauke eraun atutubet naka ekubit, alalauke da atutubet naka ekubit,
Ido ipiripiranakini amor nekiminaikina, ikokoron iwonon luka amor: ekokoro loka asadia, * ka atopasit, * ka karubunikol * ŋes eraun ckokoro losodit;
Ekokoro lokiareit loka emeralid, * ka asapiro, * ka diamod*;
Ekokoro lokiwuniet loka eyasit, * ka aget,* ka ametusit*;
Ka ekokoro lokiwoŋonet loka aberul, * ka naemelomelot, * ka ayaseper
Nu kere eraas amor nuegelegela nuka etiai loepol.

Eraunos amor kwape ejaatar ikiroria luka idwe luka Isiracl, atomon ka nuarei, kwape ejaatar ikiroriakec; kwape igiria emacar, niniruŋanan kwape ejaar ekekiror, eraunos kanuka atekerin atomon ka nuarei.
Ido ibwaikini toma yenikatorob irikoi kwape kaunoi, luka aswam naeoiitoi naka esabu kaloelai.
Ibwaikini da igilun iarei luka esabu toma yenikatorob, ibwaikini igilun Ŋul iarei osaŋeta iarei luka yenikatorob.
Ibwaikini irikoi iarei luka esabu lueojitoi toma ogilun iarei lukosaneta luka yenikatorob.
Ibwaikini isaneta ice luka irikoi nul luarei lueojitoi toma apesan kwa aarei, kosodi aibwaikin okeperin luka epod, kowaike lokoinaren.
Iswamauni da igilun iarei luka esabu, ibwaikini toma osaŋeta iarei luka yenikatorob, toma atokitoitike, naejai owai Iokotoma loka epod.
Iswamauni igilun iarei luka esa bu, kosodi aibwaikin toma atutubeta aarei nuka ikeperin luka epod kwapuke, kowai lokoiŋaren, eiduny kaimorikikinetake, kuju aenet naka epod naicipitai kapirianut.
Eenikinete igilun luka yenikatorob ka igilun luka epod keusi lobululu, tetere iboie kokuju aenet naka epod naicipitai kapirianut, tetere mam yenikatorob ilaiakin kepod.
Ido enapenenei Aaron ikiroria luka idwe luka Isirael kotoma yenikatorob yeniketube kotauke, naelomanaria aibois nakalaunan, araun aisiitunet natir kakonyen nuka EJAKAIT.
Urim ka Tumim Apoloukec Aica ka Nuibccokino.
toma yenikatorob ycniketube; ejaununos otau loka Aaron, naelomanaria akonyen nuka EJAKAIT: enapenenei Aaron etube loka idwe luka Isirael kotauke tiritir kakonyen nuka EJAKAIT.
Iswamauni ekaso loka epod korai kere lobululu.
Ejaun apedot kotomake neitori akou: ejaun atokitoit p-aka aswam naicipitai airimor apedotoke, kwape kapedot naka ekooti loka acuma, kinyek acilio.
Toma atweleike iswamakin akamamagan nuka lobululu, ka lomuge, ka Lokareŋan, airimor atwelei kere; ka icirin luka esabu kidinikec airimor:
Ecirit loka esabu ka akamamaga, ka ecirit loka esabu ka akamamaga, airimor atwelei nuka ekaso.
Ido enapenenei Aaron aiiaanakinia: iiranario da aruokec naelomanaria aibois nakalaunan akonycn nuka EJAKAIT, naelomununia da, kinyek atwanare.
Iswamauni amekemeket nakesabu kaloelai, kigirak ŋes, kwape igiria emacar ebe, IKALAUNAN YENIKA EJAKAIT.
Ieni keusi lobululu, ido ejaun ogoe lokieniena akou; ejaenena kiŋaren kegoe lokieniena akou.

Ido ejaenena oreet loka Aaron, ibwokenenei Aaron numam adolit nuka iboro lukalaunak, luitalaunete idwe luka Isirael kotoma ainakinetakec kere nukalaunak; ejaenena oreet loka Aaron apaarasia kere, tetere ecamunio kes kakonyen nuka EJAKAIT.
Icipuni ekooti locerer loka ebaputa kaloejok, iswamauni da kebaputa kaloejok egoe lokieniena akou, iswamauni aenetait naka aŋabet, aswam naka ekasonyan.
Ido iswamakini idwe luka Aaron ikootin, iswamakini kes aeneta nuka aŋabes, akopiran da iswamakini kes, kanuka aibuses ka ajokis.
Itanapi kes Aaron onacekon, ka odweke; inyonyoikini kes akinyet, itiakuni kes, italauni kes, tetere keiaanakinete eoŋ kosasedotene.
Iswamakini kes ipalei luka ebaputa arapakinia awatekec nuejaas titai; egeunete kanabes kiton amurwos:

Enapenenei Aaron, ka odweke, naelomanariata toma owema loka airiamunun, arai naikunyakiniata otem aijaanakin kotoma aibois nakalaunan; tetere mam ibwokete numam adolit, kosodete atwakare: eraun ekisil kamake ka aurike naetupanakini ikar kere.
